chapter: The Big Top (circus, #690) - Clowns, third round on the owner's ear: B (spatial) kept, the sweet plucking out, a high moment in
purpose: Master of Game/Music/bigtop-clowns.ogg, one of the bigtop family's recordings (#690): written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository; this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan -- batch-690.ps1 -> generate-music.ps1 -Loop -NoCotCaption

request.caption: Modern synth-pop instrumental: bouncy synth bass, crisp punchy electronic drums, a bright catchy analog synth lead, a big build-up into a soaring euphoric peak with wide supersaw chords, glossy modern production, wide stereo mix with instruments panned left and right, stereo delays, spacious reverb, no vocals
request.lm_negative_prompt: vocals, singing, audience applause, crowd noise, live recording, polka, oompah brass band, marching band, toy piano, music box, childish, cute, sugary, plucked strings, long drum-only sections, drum solo, boomy sub bass, distorted bass

round: Third round (2026-10-02) on the owner's ear: the first render "too exaggerated, warm-sweet, infantile"; a spatial re-render "better, wide stereo, a good beat, great sound - but still sweet plucking, and a high moment is missing". Toy piano and music box out of the brief and into the negative, a build-up into a euphoric peak in; candidate c3 of three, chosen for the contrast in its loop - a breakdown 13 dB down and the return - its seam and its width.
